# Clearframe IDE Color Sync Reference

Antigravity IDE builds on VS Code workbench settings (`workbench.colorCustomizations`). When you switch the chat canvas to a Clearframe preset (such as `Mekong Morning` or `Deep Ink`), keeping the code editor in default dark blue creates harsh contrast jumps.

## Key Tokens Generated by `export_ide_sync.py`

- **Surfaces:** `editor.background`, `sideBar.background`, `activityBar.background`, `editorGroupHeader.tabsBackground`, `panel.background`, `statusBar.background`, `terminal.background`
- **Typography & Focus:** `editor.foreground`, `focusBorder`, `contrastBorder`, `editorCursor.foreground`
- **Accessible Scrollbar (`WCAG 1.4.11 >= 3:1`):** `scrollbarSlider.background`, `scrollbarSlider.hoverBackground`, `scrollbarSlider.activeBackground` (fixes invisible dark-mode scrollbars)
- **Diff View:** `diffEditor.insertedTextBackground` and `diffEditor.removedTextBackground` (pass `--cvd-safe` for blue/amber separation friendly to deuteranopia & protanopia)
